value.title: Required form values gate final Save while incomplete drafts remain recoverable
value.statement: Authoritative NGW required metadata survives import, local config and Parcel; a flag-only change never rebuilds the feature table. Both form types and toolbar/Back Save validate all fields including inactive tabs and dependent values before feature/attachment writes. Null, whitespace and the legacy Нет значения placeholder fail; не применимо, zero and false pass. Optional fields remain unchanged and drafts retain fields, geometry and photos. Connected NGW Field.required, nullable SQL columns and NGFP control defaults are separate contracts; a missing template flag or nullable column does not establish a tenant server flag. Legacy classobj/typeobj defaults are raw STRING choices and do not override valid explicit/draft/cursor state. TextEdit max_string_count controls requested line presentation, never resource identity or text length.
